item.description: El Papa León XIV ha regresado este miércoles a Perú, donde vivió más de 20 años en varios periodos como misionero, párroco y obispo. Estará allí hasta el lunes, día 16 de noviembre, y a lo largo de estos seis días visitará cuatro grandes ciudades. item.description: Once thought to have been looted by Scottish tribes, the gilded limb is the centrepiece of a new exhibition on Roman Scotland in Edinburgh A large bronze leg found in a bog in rural Scotland more than 200 years ago and then hidden away in a duke’s storeroom is helping to rewrite the history of the Roman empire. Antiquarians argued that the so-called Mislington leg had been looted, perhaps from York, hacked off by marauding Scottish tribes and carried north over Hadrian’s Wall. “We cannot visualise the conditions which would have led to its erection anywhere north of the Great Wall,” said one… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

At the heart of the Dec. 2 auction is The Last Sitting, a series of photographs taken in June and July 1962 at the Hotel Bel-Air in Los Angeles, just weeks before Monroe's death. FRANCE 24's Olivia Bizot reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

Pese a algunos avances, la entidad advierte de un contexto de violencia "muy desafiante" en el país, con más de un tercio de sus territorios amenazados por la actuación de grupos armados ilegales. item.title: General strike over housing brings out tens of thousands in Spain
item.description: Tens of thousands of protesters marched across Spain on Wednesday during a general strike over housing affordability and purchasing power just weeks before an early general election. Unions reported a significant response in some sectors in Spain's first nationwide 24-hour stoppage since 2012, but business leaders played down the participation. Braving heavy rain, tens of thousands of demonstrators marched through central Madrid carrying placards shaped like houses and chanting "We have no home" as they called for more affordable housing. item.title: Tens of thousands attend Polish nationalist march days after shootings
item.description: Tens of thousands of Polish nationalist sympathisers gathered in Warsaw Wednesday for an annual Independence Day March, just days after a deadly shooting spree in Krakow that shook the country. The event is held each November 11 to commemorate the ending in 1918 of 123 years of partition by Russia, Prussia and Austria. The event is a magnet for all shades of Poland's right wing -- from conservative-nationalists aligned with its Law and Justice (PiS) party to far-right and radical groups. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Amazon ha ganado fama con sus cámaras y timbres inteligentes Ring, pequeños dispositivos de seguridad que hacen bien su trabajo y que se caracterizaban por una cosa: estaban quietecitos en su sitio. Con Ring Robotics eso cambia a partir de ahora porque sus nuevos dispositivos, un dron y un robot doméstico , podrán campar a sus anchas por casa. Ambos prometen una vigilancia más completa gracias a que se pueden mover (y a la IA), pero, claro, hay una pregunta que hacerse: ¿queremos realmente que una cámara autónoma recorra los espacios más íntimos de nuestra vida? ¿Y que sea de Amazon? Índice… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: "Por la economía, para reducir el coste de vida", el slogan a favor de la acción climática en la COP31
item.description: El mensaje, que se repite en la conferencia anual de la ONU, refleja el esfuerzo por captar la atención de Estados y Gobiernos que enfrentan conflictos y crisis que han puesto al cambio climático en un segundo plano en las prioridades. Según el secretario general, se debe alcanzar consenso en torno a cuatro principios: el fin de la dependencia de los combustibles fósiles, la adaptación a un mundo más cálido, elevar el apoyo a los países vulnerables y promover la cooperación frente al conflicto. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Tehran will strike US bases in Europe if used to attack Iran, security chief says
item.description: Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei said Wednesday that Tehran would attack US bases located in Europe if they were used to carry out bombing raids against the Islamic republic. The heavy defeat of US President Donald Trump's Republican Party in the midterm elections earlier this month seems to have pushed Washington to pull back its threats to carry out fresh strikes against Iran. Fuente: France 24 - English.
